title: int:Market
description: A single energy market slot defining the trading window and delivery period. Subclass of cim:MarketDocument. Mirrors the Rust EwdsMarketDto (camelCase wire form).

marketId.description: Market ID returned as a lowercase UUID. New markets use random UUIDv4; uniqueness by community, type and delivery start is enforced on-chain. IRI: int:marketId.

openingTime.description: Market opens for order submission. IRI: int:openingTime. ISO 8601 with timezone. Must be < closingTime.

closingTime.description: Market closes for order submission. IRI: int:closingTime. ISO 8601 with timezone. Must be > openingTime and <= deliveryStartTime.

deliveryStartTime.description: Start of energy delivery period. IRI: int:deliveryStartTime. ISO 8601 with timezone.

deliveryEndTime.description: End of energy delivery period. IRI: int:deliveryEndTime. ISO 8601 with timezone. Must be > deliveryStartTime.

marketType.description: Type of market. IRI: int:marketType. Mirrors the Rust primitives::MarketType.

matchingAlgorithm.description: Market clearing algorithm applied to this slot. IRI: int:matchingAlgorithm. Mirrors the Rust primitives::MatchingAlgorithm.

createdAt.description: Record creation timestamp. IRI: int:createdAt. ISO 8601 with timezone.
